params.message:
Dates from feeds become ISO at intake, and one bad date no longer blanks a strength

1,073 web signals carried dates like 'Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:47:02 BST', which
JavaScript reads as NaN; one of them in a trend's evidence made strengthOf NaN, and
five trends had no strength from the day they were written. normalizeDate (core/
dates.mjs) turns zone abbreviations with one meaning into offsets and gives null for
the rest; makeSignal uses it. strengthOf falls back to the ingest date for a date it
cannot read. bin/fix-signal-dates.mjs rewrites the existing ones, kept for undo.
